Description.Scope of Services:
The project will rehabilitate approximately 570 linear feet of roadway on Sonoma Avenue between Farmers Lane and Hahman Drive to address failing and deteriorating pavement conditions while implementing shared bike/bus lanes and upgrading pedestrian curb ramps to current ADA standards.
Portland cement concrete overlay technology will be utilized to reduce costs, construction
time and associated traffic impacts while extending pavement life. Water services within the
project limits will be replaced. Sidewalk will be added to fill missing gaps on both sides of
Sonoma Avenue.

Description.Scope of Services: The City of Santa Rosa Planning and Economic Development Department seeks up to ten (10) qualified individuals to conduct Administrative Hearings, primarily for the Code Enforcement Division, and other City Departments as needed. The City holds Administrative Hearings monthly with AHOs presiding based on a rotating schedule. The term of service is one, seven-year term that shall not be extended without re-applying through a future proposal process. AHOs will be compensated at a rate of $351.77 per hour, with a five percent (5%) increase annually. AHOs will be compensated for up to two hours of travel time, to and from the hearing site, as well as a minimum of one and one-half hours for each noticed hearing.
